newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CARLING PUTS LOVE BEFORE LIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CARLING PUTS LOVE BEFORE LIONS.

text.p: Will Carling has ruled himself out of the British Lions tour to South Africa later this year because he wants to go on holiday with his girlfriend.
Carling told Lions manager Fran Cotton of his decision after scoring one of England's four tries in their record 41-13 win over Scotland at Twickenham on Saturday, telling him he wanted "some peace".
"My body and mind need a rest and at the end of the season I feel I need to take time off," the former England captain told the Mail on Sunday newspaper.

"This summer I want to take stock and enjoy a proper private holiday without even thinking of rugby for a while. I just don't want another two months at the end of this season on a very public tour surrounded by the South African media as well as the normal gang."

The 31-year-old Carling, whose marriage to a television presenter ended in divorce last year, is currently living with girlfriend Ali Cockayne, whose sister Michelle is married to former England soccer captain Gary Lineker.
